worldType: cozy realistic nighttime home adventure with gentle picture-book whimsy; sounds may be visualized as small friendly rhythm marks, but the world remains non-magical

locations.name: Child's room by the window
locations.description: A quiet, cozy bedroom at night whose outer wall has two separate openings onto a small balcony: a small listening window at child chest height, and a full-height glazed balcony door beside it. The room feels safe and dim rather than scary.
locations.lighting: Very low blue nighttime light from outside, with small warm highlights from Uri's neck flashlight when it turns on.

anchors.description: Low child-height window with sill, curtain edges, and a view toward the balcony.
Wall area beneath and beside the window where faint ticking sounds seem to come from.
Soft, uncluttered floor near the window for cautious crouching and stepping.

locations.topology: The room's outer wall carries TWO separate, differently-sized openings onto the SAME balcony: a small chest-height listening window, and further along the same wall a full-height glazed balcony door that is the way out. The child listens at the window (pages 1-3) and steps through the door onto the balcony; the window view frames the balcony railing and the bucket area beyond.

locations.name: Small balcony under the window
locations.description: A compact nighttime balcony with a dry metal railing, a simple chair, one loose slipper on the floor, and an old tin bucket near the outer edge where water drips make rhythms.
locations.lighting: Dark blue night ambience with a tiny warm, shaky flashlight beam creating bright spots on metal, floor, chair leg, slipper, and bucket.

anchors.description: Dry metal railing that can echo small taps.
Flat balcony floor where the flashlight beam can hop from place to place.
One visible chair leg close to the path of the flashlight beam.
One simple slipper lying on the balcony floor.
Outer balcony edge where the small old tin bucket waits under a gentle drip.

locations.topology: From the threshold, the balcony opens first to the railing area, then to the bucket corner at the edge; the chair leg and slipper sit along the floor path between them.

wardrobe.description: Cozy nighttime sleepwear: deep teal long-sleeved pajama top and matching pajama pants with tiny pale-yellow moon-and-dot pattern, plus warm cream socks; practical and soft for a quiet night investigation.
forbidden: jewelry or accessories that distract from the quiet nighttime scene

wardrobe.description: A simple soft collar or tiny chest harness holding a small round flashlight at the front of the neck; otherwise no clothing, keeping the fox natural and expressive.

recurringProps.name: Uri's neck flashlight
recurringProps.description: Tiny round flashlight attached to Uri's collar or harness; its beam is small, warm, slightly shaky, and often points comically at the wrong thing, including Uri's nose.
recurringProps.material: matte plastic or painted metal flashlight on a soft fabric collar/harness
recurringProps.scale: small enough to sit comfortably at the front of a small fox's neck
recurringProps.persistence: appears from page 2 onward; remains the same object through the final page, glowing small and warm

recurringProps.name: old tin bucket
recurringProps.description: Small old bucket at the balcony edge; initially mysterious and too quiet, then revealed as the source of metallic and soft water-drop rhythms.
recurringProps.material: slightly shiny galvanized tin with soft worn edges, not sharp or rusty-dangerous
recurringProps.scale: small child-manageable bucket, about knee height to the child when standing
recurringProps.persistence: first clearly revealed on page 5; remains in the bucket corner through page 12; shifts slightly on page 9

recurringProps.name: falling water drops
recurringProps.description: Gentle individual droplets falling into or near the bucket, making tick, tack, and soft plup sounds; may be shown with tiny friendly ripple and rhythm marks.
recurringProps.scale: single small droplets, never a stream or flood
recurringProps.persistence: heard from page 1; visually emphasized from page 7 onward; slows to a last soft drop on page 12

recurringProps.name: bedroom window
recurringProps.description: The SMALL bedroom window the ticking is heard through — the page-1 listening spot. It is a WINDOW and NOT the way out: the balcony is reached through the separate full-height glazed balcony door at the threshold. Two distinct openings on the same wall, never one.
recurringProps.material: painted wood or simple metal frame with glass and soft curtains
recurringProps.scale: small — about the width of the child's shoulders, sill at the crouching child's chest height; visibly SMALLER and higher than the full-height balcony door
recurringProps.persistence: the SAME small bedroom window wherever it appears; never enlarged into, merged with, swapped for, or drawn as the full-height glazed balcony door — the window and the door stay two visibly different openings on every page

recurringProps.name: dry metal railing
recurringProps.description: Balcony railing that makes a clear echo when tapped, turning the unknown sound into a game.
recurringProps.persistence: important on pages 3-4 and remains part of the balcony background afterward

recurringProps.name: chair leg
recurringProps.description: One simple chair leg that catches Uri's wandering flashlight beam on the way to the bucket.
recurringProps.persistence: visible in the bucket-corner environment from page 5 onward as background continuity

recurringProps.name: single balcony slipper
recurringProps.description: One loose slipper on the balcony floor, briefly lit by the flashlight beam.
recurringProps.material: soft fabric or rubber house slipper
recurringProps.scale: adult or household slipper, clearly separate from the child's socks
recurringProps.persistence: appears on page 5 and may remain near the bucket corner as a background object

recurringProps.name: gentle rhythm marks
recurringProps.description: Small hand-lettered visual sound cues such as טיק, טאק, פלופ, and soft dotted beats, used sparingly to make listening visible.
recurringProps.material: drawn graphic marks integrated into the illustration
recurringProps.scale: small, airy marks that do not dominate the scene
recurringProps.persistence: may appear wherever the sound is central, especially pages 3-12

recurringProps.name: imaginary notebook
recurringProps.description: Uri's pretend notebook on page 3 — a playful thought-doodle he mimes writing in, never a real physical prop and never in the child's hands.
recurringProps.persistence: only ever Uri's, and only on page 3; if drawn at all it stays a light doodle, not a solid object
